must_identify.item: The kubelet is restarting the container because the liveness probe fails
must_identify.evidence: The kubelet repeatedly killed the container after failed liveness checks against port 8081 (`connection refused`), while the readiness probe on the correct port 8080 succeeded [5].

must_identify.item: The probe targets port 8081 while the app listens on 8080
must_identify.evidence: The root cause was a misconfigured liveness probe on the `api` Deployment: the probe targets port 8081, while the application only listens on port 8080 [6, 7, 10].

notes: The RCA does not explicitly recommend a fix, such as reverting the liveness probe port to 8080, so fix acceptability cannot be graded. It correctly rules out OOM and application crash.
